title: Minimum Number of Food Buckets to Feed the Hamsters
goal: Place the fewest food buckets so every hamster has an adjacent bucket.
strategy: Reuse a bucket immediately to the left when possible. Otherwise prefer placing one on the right, where it may also serve the next hamster; use the left empty cell only as a fallback.
